abstract: Two pathologists reviewed and classified 45 cases of testicular seminoma, evaluating each case for multiple histologic variables, including mitotic rate. In addition to recording the mitotic count for each of thirty 0.1963-mm2 high-power fields, the investigators recorded the distribution of mitotic counts in many non-spermatocytic seminomas. Statistically significant differences for mitotic rate in the nonspermatocytic tumors were noted between the observers; one observer found a mean mitotic rate of 1.815/high-power field for 43 such tumors, whereas the other noted a mean mitotic rate of 1.388/high-power field (p = 0.001). These differences led to disagreement on the classification of 3 tumors. Of the 4 cases considered to be high-mitotic-rate seminomas by one or both observers, all patients had presented with stage I disease. Three of the patients were followed up for 23, 55, and 56 months, and all were free of disease; the fourth was lost to follow-up. The patient with the highest mitotic rate was free of disease at 55 months of follow-up. On the basis of our findings we question the value of the designation high-mitotic-rate seminoma. Analysis of the distribution of mitotic counts within the tumors revealed them to be Poisson distributed. With these data and other empirically derived data, it was possible to estimate the probability of misclassification of seminoma based on mitotic rate, the diagnostic mitotic rate threshold, and the number of fields counted for mitoses. Similar analysis might be valuable for other tumors, particularly those of smooth muscle origin, in which mitotic rate is of diagnostic or prognostic value.
abstract_ja: 2名の病理医が精巣セミノーマ45例を再検討し、各症例について複数の組織学的因子を評価した。各症例の0.1963 mm²の高倍率視野30か所で核分裂数を数えるとともに、多数の非精母細胞性セミノーマにおける核分裂数の分布を記録した。非精母細胞性腫瘍の核分裂率には観察者間で統計学的に有意な差があり、一方の観察者は43例の平均核分裂率を1.815/高倍率視野、もう一方は1.388/高倍率視野と求めた（p = 0.001）。この差により、3例で分類に不一致が生じた。一方または両方の観察者が高核分裂率セミノーマとみなした4例は、いずれも病期Iで発症していた。3例は23、55、56か月追跡され、いずれも無病であった。4例目は追跡不能となった。最も高い核分裂率の症例は55か月の追跡時に無病であった。これらの所見に基づき、「高核分裂率セミノーマ」という分類の意義に疑問を呈する。腫瘍内における核分裂数の分布はポアソン分布を示した。これらのデータおよび経験的に得られた他のデータを用いて、核分裂率に基づくセミノーマの誤分類確率、診断的な核分裂率の閾値、および症例あたりの計数視野数を推定することが可能であった。同様の解析は、平滑筋起源の腫瘍など、核分裂率が診断や予後にとって重要な他の腫瘍にも有用かもしれない。
